title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 07:58:40 最新章节：第209章 剑冢之门
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
疼。
不是被矿石砸的那种疼。
是火舌舔上脚底板的那种疼。
皮肉在高温下收缩、焦裂、冒油，痛感沿着脊椎骨一路蹿上来，像有人拿烧红的铁丝从脚后跟往脑仁里捅。
苏意是被活生生疼醒的。
他睁开眼，看见的是倒悬的天空。
灰蒙蒙的天，矿渣山的黑影子倒挂在视野上方，晃来晃去。
嘴里涌进一股腥甜的液体——是血，从倒流的鼻腔灌进嗓子眼。
他想动，动不了。
手脚被什么东西死死捆着，手腕脚腕勒得发麻。
然后他意识到自己是倒吊着的。
赤条条的。
一根粗木棍从手脚之间穿过去，像串畜生一样把他串起来。
木棍两头架在石头垒的简易烤架上。
烤架底下堆着矿渣和碎木头，火苗正从矿渣缝里往上蹿。
一个满脸横肉的壮汉蹲在火堆旁，拿一截铁管往火里吹气，腮帮子鼓得像蛤蟆。
火苗呼地蹿高了一截。
苏意感觉小腿上的汗毛全卷了。
“牛能哥，这火候差不多了吧？”
吹火的壮汉抬头，舔了舔嘴唇上的煤渣，“皮都起泡了。”

被叫牛能的人从烤架后面转出来。
三角眼，刀疤从左边眉骨拉到右边下颌——那道疤不像旧伤，粉红色的肉芽还翻着，像一条刚孵出来的蜈蚣趴在脸上。
他手里攥着一把盐，矿上腌肉用的粗盐粒，灰白色，掺着矿渣。
“急什么。”
牛能在苏意面前蹲下来，仰头看着倒吊的他，咧嘴笑了。
牙缝里塞着黑面饼的残渣。
“这小子细皮嫩肉的，得慢慢烤。
急火烤出来的肉，外焦里生，咬一口一嘴血水——那不就浪费了？”
他拍了拍苏意的脸。
“你说是不是？”
苏意的嘴被布条勒着，说不出话。
他的眼睛越过牛能那张刀疤脸，扫了一圈周围。
矿场。
塌方的矿场。
不远处的矿洞口塌了大半，碎石堆成小山，灰土还在往外涌。
矿奴们蹲在空地上，黑压压一片，有的脸上糊着血，有的光着脚，有的腿上被碎石划开的口子还在往外渗血。
没有人敢动。
几个监工提着鞭子站在外围，鞭梢上沾着碎肉。
矿难。
他明白了。

矿难刚过，矿道塌了，储粮的库房大概也被埋了。
这群监工没东西吃，就把主意打到了矿奴身上。
打到了他身上。
content_en:
pain.
It's not the kind of pain you feel when you're hit by an ore.
It's the kind of pain like flames licking the soles of your feet.
The skin and flesh shrank, cracked, and emitted oil under the high temperature. The pain shot up along the spine, as if someone was stabbing a red-hot wire from the heel to the brain.
Su Yi woke up from the pain.
He opened his eyes and saw the sky hanging upside down.
On a gray sky, the black shadow of the slag mountain hung upside down above the field of vision, dangling back and forth.
A sweet liquid poured into his mouth - it was blood, pouring into his throat from his nasal cavity.
He wanted to move but couldn't.
His hands and feet were tied tightly with something, and his wrists and ankles were numb.
Then he realized he was hanging upside down.
Naked.
A thick wooden stick passed between his hands and feet, stringing him up like an animal.
The two ends of the wooden sticks are placed on a simple grill built with stones.
There were piles of slag and broken wood under the grill, and flames were jumping up from the cracks in the slag.
A strong man with a sinewy face squatted beside the fire, blowing air into the fire with an iron pipe, his cheeks bulging like a toad.
The flames shot up higher.
Su Yi felt that the hairs on her calves were all curled up.
"Brother Niu Neng, is the heat almost done?"
The strong man blowing the fire looked up and licked the cinders on his lips, "The skin is blistered."
The man called Niu Neng came out from behind the grill.
Triangular eyes, a scar stretching from the left brow bone to the right chin - the scar doesn't look like an old wound, the pink granulation is still turned over, like a newly hatched centipede lying on the face.
He held a handful of salt in his hand, the coarse salt grains used to marinate meat in the mines, gray-white, mixed with slag.
"What's the rush?"
Niu Neng knelt down in front of Su Yi, looked up at him hanging upside down, and grinned.
There are remnants of black flour cake stuck between the teeth.
“This kid has thin skin and tender meat, so it needs to be roasted slowly.
The meat roasted over a rapid fire will be burnt on the outside and raw on the inside, and you will get blood when you bite it - isn't that a waste? "
He patted Su Yi's face.
"You think so?"
Su Yi's mouth was tied with a piece of cloth and she couldn't speak.
His eyes crossed Niu Neng's scarred face and glanced around.
Mine.
Collapsed mine.
Most of the mine entrance not far away collapsed, rubble piled up into a hill, and dust was still pouring out.
The mine slaves were squatting in the open space, covered in darkness. Some had blood on their faces, some were barefoot, and blood was still oozing out from the wounds on some legs cut by gravel.
No one dared to move.
Several overseers stood outside with whips, the tips of which were stained with minced meat.
Mining disaster.
He got it.
Just after the mining disaster, the mine tunnel collapsed and the grain storage warehouse was probably buried.
The overseers had nothing to eat, so they turned to the mine slaves.
Hit him.
